modal_policy: Runtime modal inventory. Routeable modal criteria are defined in docs/07-routing.md and enforced by scripts/qa/check-navigation-registry.js.

order.ticket.route.routing_reason: Trading ticket is a transaction flow that benefits from refresh recovery, deep links, and external task entry while rendering the visible operation page through the global BottomSheet host.

discover.layout.route.routing_reason: Current route-backed configuration layer; consider demoting if deep link or recovery is not required.

non_routeable_modals.auth.countryPicker: Country picker sheet for phone flows.
non_routeable_modals.auth.languageSheet: Language picker sheet for Auth header actions.
non_routeable_modals.global.bottomSheet: Shared BottomSheet host and presets for all mobile bottom-sheet interactions.
non_routeable_modals.global.modalQueue: Global queued Alert Dialog for blocking risk, dirty-state, funding, trading, security, partner role-change, and portfolio order-mutation feedback.
non_routeable_modals.global.modalStack: Full-screen modal stack host for complex modal content such as trading terminal chart.
non_routeable_modals.quick.actionSheet: Quick actions content rendered through shared BottomSheet actionMenu preset.
non_routeable_modals.funding.paymentMethodSheet: Funding payment or payout method selection sheet.
non_routeable_modals.funding.submitFeedbackAlert: Funding submit reference feedback through queued Alert Dialog.
non_routeable_modals.discover.profileEditSheet: Profile edit sheet rendered through public BottomSheet opener.
non_routeable_modals.discover.managerChatSheet: Manager chat preview sheet rendered through public BottomSheet opener.
non_routeable_modals.portfolio.closePositionConfirm: Close position confirmation through shared ConfirmActionSheet.
non_routeable_modals.partner.upgradeFeedbackAlert: Partner role-change submit, pending, and approval feedback through queued Alert Dialog.
non_routeable_modals.portfolio.orderMutationAlert: Position close and pending-order mutation feedback through queued Alert Dialog.

hard_rules: Non-routeable modal entries must not define routePath.
Ordinary confirmation, success, failure, toast, tips, delete confirmation, and picker sheets must not be independent routes.
Only routeable modals may point to paths in routeRegistry.
